t: You're looking at the gate piers, gates, railings and lamps across the front of Buckingham Palace, a Grade I listed ensemble in the City of Westminster. Several hands made it. John Thomas, a sculptor and architect who worked on both Buckingham Palace and the Palace of Westminster, is credited, as are the sculptors William Silver Frith and Walter Gilbert, and the Swiss artist Louis Weingartner. Gilbert came up through the Bromsgrove Guild, where he worked alongside Weingartner. So the ironwork and ornament in front of you reflect a collaboration between craftspeople and sculptors, rather than the work of one designer.
